حّلَّةٌ : see مَحَلٌّ. ＝
-A2- A large basket, (K,) or a thing of the form of a large basket, (Sgh, TA,) of reeds, or canes, (Sgh, K, TA,) in which wheat is put: so in the conventional language of the people of Baghdád: (Sgh, TA:) but in that of Egypt, a copper cooking-pot: (TA:) [pl. حِلَلٌ.] ＝
-A3- The direction (جِهَة, and قَصْد,) of a thing; as also ↓ حِلَّةٌ : (K:) as when you say حلَّةَ الغَوْرِ in the direction of the Ghowr; syn. قَصْدَهُ. (Sb, TA.) ＝
-A4- فِيهِ حَلَّةٌ In him is weakness, and languor; as also ↓ حِلَّةٌ . (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
